# Job Application Agent

> Job-search and application infrastructure for AI agents.

Public docs:
- /agents - agent capabilities and connection model
- /api - REST API quickstart
- /mcp-docs - MCP quickstart and tool list
- /job-search-api - job discovery/matching API overview
- /resume-tailoring-api - truthful resume tailoring API overview
- /ai-job-application-agent - full application-agent overview

Core capabilities:
- search matched jobs
- explain fit scores
- tailor resumes from verified career facts
- truth-check generated claims
- prepare applications
- submit only with explicit authorization
- track application status
